result.summary: The page is mostly intact, but the promotional banner has a serious contrast failure: its headline and promo code text are white on a very light mint background and are nearly unreadable. No other significant visual breakage was found; the clipped carousel items and the bottom-cut pizza card are expected scrolling behavior.

issues.description: The promo banner's headline "3 free deliveries for you" and subtext "Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10" are white on a pale mint-green background. Contrast is extremely low, so the offer and the promo code are almost invisible. Only the "Order now" button is legible.
issues.suggestion: Use a dark text color (e.g. dark green or near-black) on the light mint background, or darken the banner background to a saturated brand green so white text reaches at least 4.5:1 contrast.
